projects.name: Project Manager
details: March 2013 – March 2023
• Enabled transitioning of procurement processes from manual and local systems to a global platform through MVC tool implementation.
• Supported implementation of Ivalua tool for Contract and Requisition modules, ensuring process mapping and
data quality.
• Conducted User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for contracting, sourcing, and requisition modules to verify
functionality and compliance.
• Facilitated implementation of DocuSign tool for electronic execution of third-party contracts.
• Delivered training and user guidance for DocuSign, providing end-to-end support for global users.
• Performed Quality Audit Reviews (QAR) on global contracts across various categories to maintain compliance.
• Developed user guides and quick reference materials for Ivalua, tailored to diverse user roles.
• Generated reports in Ivalua based on contract and requisition queries received from stakeholders.
• Onboarded Confluence platform, migrating training materials to improve accessibility and user experience.
Executive – Procurement
HSBC Software Development India Ltd, Pune
